G: Multi-camera dash cam system with a 6.25-inch touchscreen display hub, built-in wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. Records 1440P front, 1080P cabin and 1440P rear using Sony STARVIS 2 sensors. Includes AI driver alerts, HUD mode, voice control in 5 languages, Wi-Fi 6, built-in GPS, 24/7 parking mode and microSD support up to 1TB. Can be upgraded with Vantrue's Thermal Smart Module, which is included in the P2 Thermal and Full System packages.
H: The Vantrue Pilot 2 is a smart dash cam system that combines multi-camera recording with a dedicated 6.25-inch touchscreen display. It turns almost any vehicle into a modern smart cockpit. Unlike standard dash cams with a small screen on the camera, the Pilot 2 uses a separate dash-mounted display hub (1560 x 720 IPS touchscreen) that connects all the cameras and runs the whole system. The windshield camera has no screen, so it stays small and out of the driver's line of sight.

H: Cameras: The Dashcam System records three views at once. A compact windshield unit holds a 1440P front camera and a 1080P cabin camera, and a separate 1440P rear camera covers the road behind. The front camera uses a Sony STARVIS 2 IMX675 sensor with a 158° field of view for clear detail day and night, and the rear camera has a 165° field of view. Vantrue's PlatePix technology is designed to make licence plates easier to read in strong backlight and low light. The display can show one camera or all of them at once.

Smart Display: The touchscreen has built-in wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, which adds navigation, music, calls and messages to older vehicles that don't have them. A HUD mode shows key driving information, and voice control in 5 languages allows hands-free operation. The display has a built-in speaker and an auxiliary output to connect to the vehicle's sound system.

Safety and Parking: AI driver alerts help warn of hazards on the road. Four intelligent parking modes protect the vehicle when it's unattended, and the system can be hardwired to the vehicle for parking coverage.

Connectivity and Storage: Built-in GPS (housed in the windshield mount) logs route, speed and location with each recording, which helps with insurance claims and incident reviews. Wi-Fi 6 on 5GHz and the Vantrue app let owners view, download and share clips quickly. The system supports microSD cards up to 1TB.

Thermal Upgrade: The Pilot 2 is built to work with Vantrue's Thermal Smart Module, a compact IP67 waterproof thermal camera that mounts on the hood or in the grille. It detects the heat from people, animals and vehicles in total darkness, fog, smoke and heavy rain, up to 330 ft away. The thermal module is included in the P2 Thermal System and P2 Full System packages.
The Pilot 2 Dashcam System suits commuters, rideshare drivers and owners of older vehicles who want full front, cabin and rear recording plus CarPlay and Android Auto on one large screen.
